name: ot-plant-drift
description: Small OT plant over two shifts: baseline, an I/O module swapped for a new model, a PLC re-addressed, a new engineering conversation, the old HMI decommissioned.

phases.name: module-swap
phases.description: the ET 200S head PLC-S7-2 (IM151-8) is replaced by an S7-1500 CPU: new model, firmware and serial in its SZL

phases.name: ip-change
phases.description: PLC-RW2 is moved to a new address in the same cell; it announces itself with gratuitous ARPs and its pollers reconnect

phases.name: new-conversation
phases.description: the SCADA server starts polling PLC-RW2 over CIP (supervisory -> cell)

phases.name: decommission
phases.description: the Windows 2000 HMI is switched off for good
